articles.title: Very heavy departure traffic at Woodlands Checkpoint ahead of National Day weekend amid tailback from Malaysia: ICA
articles.content: Travellers departing Singapore via Woodlands Checkpoint are advised that there is currently "very heavy departure traffic" due to tailback from Malaysia. It estimated that waiting time to Woodlands Checkpoint is more than three hours. Travellers are advised to check traffic conditions before embarking on their journeys. It added that security checks have been stepped up amid a heightened global security environment and recent developments in the Middle East.
